title: test(#760): unit coverage for cohort overview aggregator
body:
Closes test-coverage gap from #760. 9 unit tests for GET /api/cohorts/overview — empty state, mastery bucketing (hi/mid/low/noData), engagement metrics, red-flag heuristic (both lapsed-side and low-mastery-side), rollup dedup math, per-caller mean averaging, trend sign, empty-cohort short-circuit guard.

All 9 pass.
